name: Pretty Please
summary: A will-you-be-mine page where a panda asks and the No button keeps running away
about: A bold, sticker-style page where a panda on a little live camera holds up a heart sign and asks your question. Every time someone reaches for No it jumps somewhere else with a puff, changes its words and shrinks, while Yes grows and the panda's ears droop until a tear rolls down. Pressing Yes sets off a hearts confetti storm, a happy panda dance and a first-date picker with a reply to copy. Good for asking someone out, a Valentine's surprise or a fun proposal sent as a link.
how: Try to press No: it runs away from the mouse, a tap or the keyboard and says something new each time.
Each try makes Yes bigger and the panda sadder; after seven tries No gives up and turns into Okay, yes.
Press Yes: hearts burst out, the panda dances and you can pick a first date and copy a reply.
In Make your own, type their name, your question and your name, then copy the link to send it.
Ask again resets everything; with reduced motion No still dodges, just without flying or wobbling.
